Give each channel a verdict of 'usable' only if it has at least 4 non-null samples. If a channel fails, check whether hydrogen has at least 4 samples in the same window and could be used instead.
result.answer:

| Gas | Non-null count | First timestamp | Last timestamp | Days with no sample | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| acetylene | 4 | 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 | 2024-01-18T00:00:00.000000 | None | **usable** |
| co | 4 | 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 | 2024-01-18T00:00:00.000000 | None | **usable** |

Because neither channel failed, I didn't need to check hydrogen as a replacement. For reference, it also has 4 daily samples in the same window.

Four points is only the minimum you set. That's very little data for a trend model, so any fitted trend will be weak.
